description: Use when the user asks a question about a project's documents in words. GeoThought answers from the project's documents and saved answers. Returns the answer with each claim cited to a document page. For a follow-up, `earlier_questions` may hold up to 3 questions asked with this tool about the same project and the answers it gave; send nothing else from the conversation.
name: geothought_ask
title: Ask a project a question
